mentions.name: Moments
mentions.description: A journaling app that captures entries via text message instead of requiring users to open an app. It grew out of a low-friction personal setup (a Twilio number and a server logging messages to a txt file committed to a GitHub repo) and was rebuilt to support photos and voice notes, produce timestamped entries with version history, and visualize the accumulated journal.
mentions.problem: Traditional journaling is high-friction, and the best thoughts tend to arrive at inconvenient times, making it hard to journal consistently.
mentions.audience: Journaling app aimed at individuals who want to capture personal thoughts on the go.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on Moments (textmoments.com). It's a journaling app that you text instead of open.
